items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: And the only one that didn't make it was Teroy, the same trombone player I'm telling you about.

ctx.x: So we had our program all set. And all we had to do was -- and we couldn't -- the show wasn't together yet. See, they were rushing it. So there wasn't no music even for us to rehearse. So we just had a wonderful -- had a ball on the boat, you see. We all of us had a wonderful trip because we all had our wives and lady friends. And the only one that didn't make it was Teroy, the same trombone player I'm telling you about.

Well, the Christmas before we left. It was Christmas in 1924, we were down at Loew's State. We played Loew's State for Christmas. We doubled at the theater, the Loew's State. And the stage director, the stage manager, had some good muscatel wine. So, we was all celebrating for Christmas. "Merry Christmas", and we'd drink. And Teroy drank too much wine, of the wine. Now, so when it was time for the show he said, "Twenty, fifteen minutes." And we were trying to get Teroy together. Teroy -- cause he was sweet. And…
